Resolve ambiguous domain terms before standardising a label grammar; test important labels through concrete cases.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Authority</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Domain participants determine meaning; model maintainers ensure consistent use without overriding legitimate local terminology.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Disposition</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>CONTEXT_DEPENDENT</p></dd></dl></li></ol></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Fields</dt><dd><ol><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Key</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>EBPM:EBPM-014</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Mechanism</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Declare whether a model communicates, analyses or drives execution, and identify the additional implementation semantics and organisational arrangements needed to move between those uses. State the proposed mechanism, plausible confounding and comparison; use stronger designs or bounded trials when an observational association could recommend the wrong intervention.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Authority</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Analysts can identify evidence limits; authorised owners decide on precaution, experimentation or non-intervention.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Disposition</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>STRONGLY_RETAINED</p></dd></dl></li></ol></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Fields</dt><dd><ol><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Key</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>EBPM:EBPM-023</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Mechanism</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Form a specific change hypothesis and compare it with plausible organisational, informational and technical alternatives, including doing nothing. Treat participation as consequential influence and learning, not attendance or consultation without effect.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Authority</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Sponsors resource participation; performers contribute operational knowledge; consultation does not erase formal accountability.</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Disposition</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM</p></dd></dl></li></ol></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Fields</dt><dd><ol><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Key</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>EBPM:EBPM-039</p></dd></dl></li><li><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Mechanism</p></dd><dt>Value</dt><dd><p>Interpret indicators in light of the behaviour they reward, omitted work and differences in case difficulty.
